stories.title: External Links Schema and Contract
stories.description: Define the frontend data contract for external verification links including site name (Healthgrades, NPI Registry, State Board), URL, link type, and guidance text. Ensure compatibility with provider_detail_service research site outputs.

stories.title: External Link Mapping and Normalization Logic
stories.description: Implement frontend logic to map backend-provided research_links into standardized UI elements, including normalization of labels, ordering (NPI first), and fallback handling when links are missing.

stories.title: UI Component for External Verification Links
stories.description: Build a frontend component to display external verification links with clear labels, outbound indicators, and short guidance text explaining what each source provides (e.g., licensing, reviews, official registry).
stories.evidence: GAP: No dedicated UI component for external provider verification links currently exists in frontend

stories.title: Safe Link Handling and Validation Integration
stories.description: Integrate URL validation and safe rendering (target=_blank, rel=noopener) for all external links, ensuring malformed or unsafe URLs are not rendered.

stories.title: External Links Rendering Tests and Integration
stories.description: Create unit and integration tests to validate correct rendering of links, ordering, fallback behavior, and safe link handling across provider detail views.
